subject.title: fix(gateway): enforce plugin-ownership check in sessions.patch

question: Should plugin-runtime `sessions.patch` require exact creator ownership and reject every legacy ownerless session row?
rationale: The patch intentionally narrows an existing trusted in-process path, so maintainers must decide whether exact creator ownership is the permanent authorization contract or whether legacy rows need a migration path.

options.title: Exact-owner fail closed
options.body: Reject foreign and ownerless rows for plugin-runtime callers while preserving operator and non-plugin recovery paths.

options.title: Migrate legacy ownership
options.body: Add an explicit doctor or operator migration that establishes safe ownership before plugin-runtime access resumes.

options.title: Design broader authority
options.body: Pause both candidate PRs and define a capability-based plugin session authority contract beyond creator ownership.

recommendation.title: Exact-owner fail closed
recommendation.body: Reject foreign and ownerless rows for plugin-runtime callers while preserving operator and non-plugin recovery paths.

likelyOwner.reason: The recent projection refactor defines the transaction ordering that must change or expose a pre-migration authorization hook.
